tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background (warm cream / deep cocoa).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, nav pill, form panel, chips that sit on `bg`.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Inset areas: skills panel, date pills, chips inside cards.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body copy on `bg`, `surface`, `surface-2`, `accent-2`. Also the fill of dark buttons and the contact band.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy, meta, dates on `bg`, `surface`, `surface-2` (≥5.8:1 light, ≥7.9:1 dark).

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on `ink` fills: dark buttons, active nav item, the contact band.

tokens.name: on-ink-accent
tokens.usage: Highlight text on `ink` fills (the contact band's eyebrow and italic word): sun yellow on cocoa in light, burnt tangerine on cream in dark.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Tangerine, the complement of the blue in the photo (and the roofs behind it): primary buttons, the portrait arch, the first stat tile, the big '7'. Never as small text on light grounds (3.1:1).

tokens.name: primary-press
tokens.usage: The extruded under-edge of primary buttons (the 3D 'press' depth).

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text on `primary` fills (5.7:1 light, 6.5:1 dark). Never white.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Harbour blue, picked from the shirt and sky in Usama's photo: eyebrows, company names, links, % badges, the second stat tile, the featured quote. White text on it in light (6.9:1), dark text in dark.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on `accent` fills.

tokens.name: accent-2
tokens.usage: Sun yellow: clay shapes, the third stat tile, review stars on dark. With `ink` text only.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: The 'Live' dot and availability dot. Always next to a word ('Live', 'Available').

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Tag outlines, input borders, dividers. Decorative — never the only thing separating controls.

tokens.name: field-border
tokens.usage: Input borders (≥3:1 on `surface`).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 3px solid, 3px offset, on every interactive element.

tokens.usage: Cards and panels.

tokens.name: radius-xl

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, tags, nav.

tokens.name: shadow-card

tokens.name: shadow-pop
